summary: Bidirectional real-time audio transport between an Agora channel and a Voxa graph.

connections.description: Use one App ID and one Channel. Generate three separate temporary RTC tokens for the exact UIDs 1001, 2001, and 2002.

fields.name: app_id
fields.label: App ID
fields.help: Paste the App ID from the same Agora project used to generate all three tokens.

fields.name: channel
fields.label: Channel
fields.help: Keep voxa-demo for the first run. Enter this exact Channel when generating every token.

fields.name: source_uid
fields.label: Ingress Bot UID
fields.help: Keep 2001. This C++ participant receives browser microphone audio.

fields.name: source_token
fields.label: Ingress Bot Token
fields.help: Generate a temporary RTC token for this App ID, Channel voxa-demo, and numeric UID 2001.

fields.name: sink_uid
fields.label: Egress Bot UID
fields.help: Keep 2002. This C++ participant publishes assistant audio.

fields.name: sink_token
fields.label: Egress Bot Token
fields.help: Generate a different temporary RTC token for the same App ID and Channel, with numeric UID 2002.

fields.name: web_uid
fields.label: Browser UID
fields.help: Keep 1001. The Voice Room uses this identity for the browser microphone.

fields.name: web_token
fields.label: Browser Token
fields.help: Generate a third temporary RTC token for the same App ID and Channel, with numeric UID 1001.
